Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD, Empyrean series 2, PANalytical) with a Cu Kα radiation of 1.54059 Å was used for phase identification and crystallography. The samples exhibited rhombohedral perovskite symmetry (space group R3̅c), with the peaks indexed by PDF #01-0736750. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) and selected area electron diffraction (SAED, JEM-2100, JEOL) were used to study the sample morphology and directly measure the d-spacing of the samples. The lattice spacing of the (012) plane and (110) plane were determined for LSM and LS1.05M.
